flavor: It is no mere infestation of rats or woodland creatures that haunts this decrepit manor. Something vile lives in Hemlock House. It burrows through the floor, writhes within its walls, and watches you with invisible, hungry eyes.
back_text:
Find the unsealed [[Dormant]] location nearest to the most investigators. Flip that location to its enemy-location side.
Attach a set-aside Fire! treachery to the leftmost location on the highest floor. Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
back_flavor: Tumultuous rain pelts the roof of the house. The sky outside is swathed in dark clouds, illuminated only by brief flashes of light in the distance. Your skin crawls as the groans and creaks are muffled by the roar of thunder and the downpour crashing against the windows. Just then, bright light floods the room, and a resounding crack booms from the top floor of the house. The smell of burning wood drifts down into the halls. Lightning has struck the house!

name: Strange Infestation
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. [action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. Objective - At the end of the round, if a total of 7 locations are sealed and/or in the victory display, advance.

[action] If your location is unsealed and [[Dormant]], investigators at that location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on it, as a seal. back_text:
If there are more seals in play than enemy-locations in the victory display:
Your efforts to suppress the strange infestation seem to have angered it. A noisome screech shakes the foundation of the house, and the air floods with a fetid stench of something awful down below.
Put the set-aside Shapeless Cellar enemy-location into play on the Cellar Floor, as close to the middle column as possible. Advance to the set-aside act 2a "The Heart of the House" and remove act 2a "Against the House" from the game.
If there are more enemy-locations in the victory display than seals in play:
The foundations of the house shake as another room threatens to collapse. If you bring this house down, the abomination that lives inside it won't survive long.
Advance to the set-aside act 2a "Against the House" and remove act 2a "The Heart of the House" from the game.

name: Against the House
text: Clues cannot be discovered from locations with no investigators. Objective - Bring this house down! If no locations are in play, immediately advance (this occurs before investigators would be defeated by not being at a location).

A swarm of insect soldiers descends upon you, blocking any escape. One of them buries its proboscis in your torso with near-mechanical efficiency. You feel pain, then numbness, then nothing as you pass out.

back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not been eliminated is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor:
A swarm of insects descends upon you, blocking any escape. One of them darts forward with almost mechanical efficiency, burying a proboscis in your torso. Sharp pain spasms through your body, followed by numbness. The milky white insect retracts a black proboscis dripping blue fluid as your vision begins to swim. Passing out is a mercy.
You come to hours later, covered in salt, in a dry chamber underground. Head pounding, you stagger out of the warrens into the arid heath. The wound in your side oozes a filmy blue poison, but it doesn't seem to be fatal...

name: A Lost Legacy
text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at the Pearl Estate Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Objective - When the round ends, investigators at the Pearl Estate Ruins may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: The legacy of Pearl Ridge is a story of note amongst the locals. The Pearls were a prominent family like the Hemlocks and Atwoods, but the family vanished in a curious incident back in 1906. What could have happened here?
back_text: Randomly put the three set-aside locations from the Horrors in the Rock encounter set into play, unrevealed, adjacent to the three starting locations as explained on page 20 of the Campaign Guide. Take the remaining set-aside locations (Salt Chamber, Larval Tunnel, and Crystal Nursery) along with the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. Shuffle them together and randomly deal 1 card facedown beneath each location.
back_flavor: Amongst the ruins of the Pearl Estate, you find Susan Pearl's diary. It details attempts to explore tunnels beneath the ridge. They were called "The Warrens" due to their mazelike structure. Perhaps some of the Pearl family disappeared in the surrounding tunnels, but why? You resolve to investigate.

flavor: The Warrens are likely the final resting place of the Pearl family. Studying their remains may shed light on what really happened here.
back_text: Check the number of Crystal Remains in the victory display. - If there are exactly 3 Crystal Remains, (→R1) (page 22). - Otherwise, (→R2) (page 22).
back_flavor: The scent of decay and the strange creatures' pheromones mix to create a uniquely awful musk. Emerging from the caverns, you lay down the last member of what you assume must be the Pearl family. The acidic residue from their strange, crystalline growths burns your skin. The bodies are painful to look at, their faces frozen in silent agony. Some invisible, heavy presence fills the air above the corpses, although there is no motion, no breeze or dust. Only a movement of something in the air. You feel a deep, bone-aching weariness.

name: Into the Caves
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: Waves crash on the shoreline, threatening to wipe out a set of footprints that lead into the tidal caverns. You catch the faintest glimpse of a dim, blue glow deep within the tunnels.
back_text: Spawn one of the set-aside Crustacean Hybrid enemies at the [[Coastal]] location nearest to the most investigators, (In the Light) side faceup. Each investigator at a [[Dark]] location must discard 1 card at random from their hand. Place doom on agenda 2a equal to the current day number.
back_flavor: A whirring, chittering sound echoes off the tunnel walls. A large, crab-like creature emerges from a nearby tidal pool, antennae swaying in the air as if searching for you. The thing moves surprisingly fast on dozens of legs, and its carapace is covered in sharp barnacles and strings of kelp and rotten seaweed. Whatever it is, it emits the most awful, rotten stench you have ever smelled.

name: Darkness Closes In
text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
real_text: Cards at [[Dark]] locations use (Night [night]) effects. Cards at all other locations use (Day [day]) effects.
flavor: The cavern walls are alive with churning, shifting fungal growths. And they seem to be following you.
back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
back_flavor:
You find yourself surrounded in the dark by dozens of shadowy forms, clacking and chittering. More unsettling still is the soft glowing moss that spreads across the slick walls and ceiling of the tidal cave. As the creatures and shifting moss press in, suffocatingly close, you lose your balance and fall into a thick carpet of moss. Up close, you see small buds and spiny growths in the moss that palpitate and turn toward you like a hundred tiny mouths.
As you feel your limbs go numb, a pair of hands pulls you from the moss. Helen Peters drags you bodily out of the cave, cursing under her breath.

name: The Missing Sibling
text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.
real_text: Forced - After the last clue is discovered from a [[Cave]] location: Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play adjacent to that location. Objective - Find Elizabeth Peters! If the investigators "found a torn dog leash" and "found a set of footprints," immediately advance.
flavor: Elizabeth Peters has gone missing in these coastal caves, chasing after the family dog. Helen is determined to get her back.
back_text:
Choose a [[Coastal]] location (with no investigators, if able). Put the set-aside Fungal Cave location into play adjacent to the chosen location.
Put the top card of the Caverns deck into play, adjacent to the Fungal Cave. Repeat this until the Fungal Cave is connected to four locations, or the Caverns deck is empty.
back_flavor:
"She's alive. Though I doubt Bruce is," Helen says, gripping the torn dog leash in one hand. You follow her as she tracks a set of footprints deeper into the darkness. As your eyes readjust to the low light, you notice the footprints glow with the leavings of the bioluminescent fungus covering the cavern floors.
"It's this way. Be ready for anything," Helen says. You steel yourself and keep step beside her. Ahead, an unsettling click and whir tell you that you are far from alone...

name: On the Trail
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - When an investigator enters Fungal Cave, immediately advance.
flavor: Lizzie's glowing footprints lead to an unexplored chamber deep in the caverns. Through your exploration, you now know how to lure the ravenous creatures with glowing moss out of the darkness and into the light.
back_text: Spawn the set-aside Limulus Hybrid at the Fungal Cave. Remove Helen Peters from the game. If Theo Peters is under the control of any investigator, ([codex] Σ) (page 25).
back_flavor:
"Helen!" Elizabeth's shrill, desperate cry cuts through the silence. A young woman with a round face and torn clothes hobbles out of the darkness to embrace her sister. As the pair embrace, their reunion is cut short by a fearsome screech. A massive crustacean the size of a house advances, pincers raised threateningly. The thing's slick, shining form is illuminated in green and blue by the cavern moss, and it emits a smell like rotten shellfish.
"Can you walk?" Helen asks her sister. Lizzie shakes her head. As the massive creature comes closer, you tell the pair to run. Helen looks torn for a moment, then nods in thanks before carrying her sister away.

name: Face to Carapace
text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - If Limulus Hybrid is defeated, immediately advance.
real_text: [action] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and choose an enemy at a connecting [[Dark]] location: Move that enemy to your location. Objective - If Limulus Hybrid is defeated, immediately advance.
flavor: The abomination from the depths of the caves stalks you through the tunnels. You can only hope you can buy Helen and her sister enough time to escape.
back_flavor: The towering abomination thrashes and squirms, its massive bulk shuddering in violent death throes. At long last, the monstrosity goes still. A filmy blue fluid leaks from its eyes and carapace, smelling like more awful, rotten shellfish. Covering your nose and mouth, you head back to Akwan.

flavor: Your vision refracts like broken glass.
back_text: All of Hemlock Isle has been transfigured in the great ascendance. Each investigator is devoured by the Colour Out of Space (they are killed).
back_flavor:
The rippling air stops, then churns into myriad faces, shapes, and forms. You struggle to breathe as the air is sucked out of your lungs and drawn into a pillar of light. The brilliance ascends into the night sky like a falling star in reverse, reducing everything around you to dust. Trees wither and desiccate, and fleeing wildlife are turned to bone and ash. Your body sublimates, rising into the blinding brilliance along with everything else on Hemlock Isle.
You have learned your place in infinity.

flavor: Dr. Marquez needs your help to save the Vale!
back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Let Dr. Marquez carry out her plan (→R1) (page 66). - Do it ourselves (→R2) (page 67). (You may only choose this if an investigator controls Prismatic Shard story asset.)
back_flavor: You stand next to Dr. Marquez at the base of a mound of desiccated bodies. Above, the Abyss flickers in the still, cold air. A hazy humanoid shape reaches toward you as the brilliance flares again, blindingly bright. "It's no good. We need to disrupt it. Feed it something it can't 'digest,'" Dr. Marquez says soberly. She hands you her satchel filled with survey notes and samples. "I want you to have this." You ask why. "Someone needs to tell Dr. Armitage the story of this..." her eyes narrow, staring up at the flickering iridescence. "...this colour out of space."

name: Fate of the Vale (v.II)

You may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues to put it into play exhausted. flavor: You'll have to either talk sense into the frenzied residents... or knock it out of them.
back_flavor: "Get in the truck!" A resident waves a crowd of dazed locals onto the vehicle. The remaining survivors pile into trucks and weather-beaten bikes and drive down the winding southern road. As you pass the dilapidated harbor, a pillar of pure light shoots up from the village center followed by an oily, viscous cloud. The train of survivors have just taken refuge in the southern lighthouse when a shockwave of hot air tears across the island with a hurricane force.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.III)
text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). [action] If your location has kindling on it equal to or greater than its shroud value, remove all kindling from it: Draw 1 set-aside Fire! treachery. (Group limit once per location.) Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
real_text: [action] Spend X [per_investigator] clues: Place X resources on your location, as kindling (you may spend 5 resources or discard an [[Item]] asset you control to place 1 additional kindling). Objective - When the round ends, if there are 5 copies of Fire! in play, immediately advance.
flavor: Your only hope of stopping this thing is to burn this accursed island. All of it.
back_flavor:
Fireworks shoot up into the sky as Hemlock Vale is consumed in the blaze. The whizzing lights and loud crackles almost distract from the devastating inferno as it devours the landscape. Poms of red, yellow, and blue fireworks launch into the air to explode in the night sky.
You and Dr. Marquez join the few remaining survivors on a trek to the island's southern reach to take refuge in a crumbling lighthouse. As you watch the inferno from a smudged window, a thread of thin, gray light shoots up from the village center, then winks out. A small, phosphorescent light plummets back into the blaze like a fallen star.

name: Fate of the Vale (v.IV)
text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
real_text: [action] If at least 5 of the following are true (the investigators found gas, the investigators found Theo's truck, the road is clear, the survey notes were recovered, Bertie is fleeing, the samples were found): Resign. You flee the Vale. Objective - Escape with your lives! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You must escape with your lives!
back_flavor:
With Dr. Marquez in tow, you gather the few survivors that remain and pile into Theo's sky blue truck. The locals shout directions as you drive south down a winding road to the southernmost point of the island. Shaking from the adrenaline, your small band of survivors takes refuge in the crumbling lighthouse.
Before you enter, you turn to see a sight you will never forget. A pillar of pure light shoots up from the Vale, drawing the oily viscous cloud in its wake. A shockwave tears across the island, and you fall to your knees, exhausted, as though years of your life were stolen from you in a single moment. You are transfixed by the dazzling light as it launches up through the stratosphere and into space.

The sweetness of the air and the vibrant colors are overwhelming. Your pulse is electric as gooseflesh creeps up your arm and your skin prickles, almost as if under an invisible caress. You are not alone, you never were alone, but the one who is with you is you, and you, and you, and you, and you and you and and and and You catch yourself staring up at the glassy sky, bewildered and drunk with wonder.

You reconvene with Dr. Marquez at the Boarding House. Bertie approaches you with a manic gleam in his eye, wearing the white-gold cloak of the Vale. "I've decided to join the Feast today - for the whole day. I understand this may put my grant in jeopardy but -" Before Dr. Marquez can chastise him, the young man scampers off past a throng of dancers.
(→R2) (page 54).
Otherwise:
You reconvene with Dr. Marquez at the Boarding House. Bertie approaches you and the professor with obvious excitement. "I've had a revelation about Hemlock Isle. The food chain is chaos. Predators predated by prey - poetic, isn't it? Something in the food or water induces a frenzy - in fact, this entire celebration is kind of frenzy," he gestures to the giddy figures and dancing children.
(→R1) (page 54).

back_flavor:
"Well done," Mother Rachel says to you. Lights dance in the sky overhead as the last of the Vale residents are led dutifully to their place at the table. Some look at you with rueful expressions, rightfully betrayed. As you move to assume your place at the table, Mother Rachel steps in your way.
"It is not your place to sit with us. You are our guest of honor," she smiles. You feel a sharp blow to the back of your head, and then nothing.

As you look around at the various markings covering the floor and walls, you hear the grinding of stone on stone behind you. You wheel about to see the secret passage sliding closed. With a resounding thud, it slams shut, leaving only an unmarked wall in its place. You’re trapped!

back_text:
If The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) is in play:
You turn around to see the Bloodless Man striding toward you with murderous intent. Before you can react, the imposing figure staggers, then falls face first onto the red carpet.

Moments later, a sharp sound of ripping cloth breaks the silence. Glistening appendages erupt from the Bloodless Man's torn suit and limbs, blossoming into a grotesque amalgam of flesh and writhing tentacles. Your stomach churns as the creature's bone-white mask stares down at you, set in a maw of nightmarish limbs and gnashing fangs.
Flip The Bloodless Man (Silent Lurker) to his (Unleashed) side.
Otherwise:
The clamor around you seems to quiet for a moment.
Each investigator may heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Guest]] asset at their location.

flavor: The party descends into utter mayhem, with guests throwing themselves out of glass doors and windows to escape the otherworldly monstrosities.

back_flavor: A rank stench pervades the once-stately manor. As more and more nightmarish creatures overtake wounded or dazed guests, you dash out from a hiding place to make a beeline for the exit. A ravenous creature, the stuff of nightmares, catches wind of your scent and pursues you doggedly to the exit. You feel its claws on your throat as you throw yourself through the solid pane of glass, straight onto a gory pile of bodies covered in lightly falling snow.

Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). flavor: Light tremors ripple through the floating landscape. The bog is a fecund jungle of bright flowers and glassy, oily reflections.
back_text: Flip the center location to its [[Sunken]] side, discarding all tokens and player card attachments. Spawn the set-aside Thing in the Depths enemy at it.
back_flavor: An ear-splitting roar resounds through the bog, followed by several ripples that roll through the floating landscape. You feel a low tremble below you, and dive to safety just before a horrible monstrosity erupts from below. Rows of thin, needle-sharp teeth gnash at the air where you just were, and ghastly stalks on eyes turn to regard you with hunger.

text: Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over. Objective – If the Thing in the Depths is defeated, (→R4).
real_text: Forced – When your turn ends, if you are at a [[Bog]] location: Place 1 damage on your location, as a sinkhole (2 sinkholes instead if there are 1 or 2 investigators in the game). Forced – If a location has 3 or more sinkholes on it: Remove all sinkholes from it and flip it over. Objective – If the Thing in the Depths is defeated, (→R4).
flavor: The bog rocks with towering waves!
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor: As your sidestep to avoid a grasping tendril, two more wrap around your legs and neck. The noisome monstrosity emerges below you, slick with ichor, and opens its wide-angled mouth. You thrash wildly, and tear at the mossy tissue gathered around the tendrils holding you. A sudden movement of a silvery blossom turns the creature's attention away from you, and it drops you to follow its new prey. You spring back to the shoreline and collapse in a dead faint at the edge of the road.

name: A Botanical Survey
text: Objective – At the end of the round, investigators at the North Shore location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (See the Location Placement diagram on page 28 of the campaign guide for the North Short location.)
real_text: Objective – At the end of the round, investigators at the North Shore location may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. (See the Location Placement diagram on page 28 of the campaign guide for the North Short location.)
flavor: The bog is supposedly the origin of the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to the island in the first place. You have your work cut out for you.
back_text:
Spawn the set-aside Chelydran Hybrid enemy at the North Shore location. Choose a location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location and spawn 1 of the set-aside Grasping Tendril enemies at that location.
Shuffle each other set-aside Grasping Tendril enemy into the encounter deck along with the discard pile.
back_flavor: You come to a round still pond on the northeastern shore of the bog. Atop a mound of wildflowers is a silvery alkaloid blossom very much like the sample that drew Dr. Marquez to Hemlock Isle. When you approach, the blossom swells to release a cloud of spores, then closes. The scent of the spores is pleasant, almost like cloves, but grows bitter the longer it lingers. Suddenly the mound of flowers moves. A large reptilian head rises out of the water and looks at you with intelligent eyes before swiftly swimming away.

name: Discovery of a Lifetime
text: [fast] Investigators at a single location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: For the remainder of the round, change Chelydran Hybrid's patrol location to that location. Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Chelydran Hybrid takes 1 damage for each ready [[Abomination]] enemy at its location. Objective – At the end of the round, if the Chelydran Hybrid is at the Starting Location, immediately advance.
real_text: [fast] Investigators at a single location adjacent to Chelydran Hybrid's location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: For the remainder of the round, change Chelydran Hybrid's patrol location to that location. Forced – At the end of the enemy phase: Chelydran Hybrid takes 1 damage for each ready [[Abomination]] enemy at its location. Objective – At the end of the round, if the Chelydran Hybrid is at the Starting Location, immediately advance.
flavor: The large flowering turtle-like creature is on the move. Perhaps you can herd it to safety.
back_text:
You corner the reptilian creature in a shining pool, where it sinks into the mud, clearly exhausted. As it starts munching on a tangle of flowers, you take several sketches and notes of the thing's sprouting shell. The alkaloid blossom on its back seems to pulse. Producing a pair of shears, you prepare to take a sample.
If it is Day 1, read the following. Otherwise, (→R1).
"Stop!" Dr. Marquez shouts. "That flower is parasitic. It is now part of the creature's anatomy. There's no telling how deeply it's embedded." She points to the flower's thick translucent stem: vicious white fluid pumps through it like an artery. "If the flower dies, its host dies too."
(→R2) (page 30).

[elder_sign] effect: +1. Search the top 3 cards of your deck for an event and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

back_text: 牌組卡牌張數：30。 屬性選擇：當牌組構建時，選擇以下一個屬性：[[幸運]]、[[局勢]]或[[臨時製品]]。 牌組構建選項: 守衛者卡牌([guardian]) 等級0-5，中立卡牌等級0-5，你所選[[屬性]]的事件卡等級0-2，最多5張其它求生者卡牌([survivor])等級0。 牌組構建需求(不計入牌組卡牌張數)：2張充滿決心、"我會自己來"、1張隨機基礎弱點。
back_flavor: 在她父親去世後，瑪麗恩從納拉甘西特海灣搬到阿卡姆。她和朋友安妮莉絲‧泰勒一起買了一艘船，兩人在這座城市的漁民社區找到了新的家園。在一個風雨交加的海上之夜，安妮莉絲被一個奇怪的魚狀生物拉到水中。瑪麗恩跳入水中，從那生物的口中救出了安妮莉絲，但代價是瑪麗恩失去了右臂。從那以後，她一直警惕著大西洋波濤洶湧的海域和潛藏其中的奇怪生物。

name: 充滿決心
text:
瑪麗恩‧塔瓦雷斯牌組專用。
如果這次技能檢定是你打出的事件卡的檢定且檢定成功，你可以不丟棄充滿決心，改為將其返回你的手牌。

name: 盧修斯‧加洛維
text:
[reaction]在你成功躲避敵人並超過難度至少2點後：發現你所在地點的1個線索。(每輪限制一次。)

real_text:
[reaction] After you successfully evade an enemy by 2 or more: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each enemy at your location.
flavor: "我只是很高興我所有的夢都留在我的腦海裡。"
back_text: 牌組卡牌張數：30。 牌組構建選項：探求者卡牌([seeker])等級0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等級0-2，中立卡牌等級0-5。 牌組構建需求(不計入牌組卡牌張數)：詩文之書、洪災之夢、1張隨機基礎弱點。
back_flavor: 盧修斯是在紐約長大的南方移居者，他與哈萊姆區的知識份子、藝術家和音樂家一起創作夢境般的詩歌，並因此聲名大噪。與他相同時代的人們不知道的是，盧修斯描述的朦朧水下城市的靈感並非來自紐約，而是來自他失蹤的夥伴魯迪的惡夢。魯迪失蹤前曾經說過，在阿卡姆有一個由入夢者組成的小團體，他們分享者這些令人不安的夢境。現在，盧修斯在米斯卡塔尼克大學擔任客座講師，他在尋找失去的愛人，或許他也在尋找自己恐怖夢境的源頭……

back_text: 牌組卡牌張數：35。 牌組構建選項：探求者卡牌([seeker])等級0-5，中立卡牌等級0-5，[[洞察]]事件卡等級0-3，最多10張其它潛修者卡牌([mystic])等級0。 牌組構建需求(不計入牌組卡牌張數)：暗眼之鏡、窺視虛空、1張隨機基礎弱點。
back_flavor: 阿加莎‧克雷恩擁有數學和心理學學位，並總是種是以證據為基礎的科學。在她年輕的時候，她對那些鬼故事不屑一顧，但越來越多的證據讓阿加莎得出結論，阿卡姆歷史上流傳的怪物和魔法的故事，的確是真實存在的。如果這些東西是真的，那麼它們就必須遵守一致的規則。任何人只要聽得夠久，她將會解釋這個新的研究領域叫做"超心理學"，她的丈夫威爾伯也聽過很多次了。阿加莎試圖用久經驗證的科學方法來位神秘和理性、神祕學和科學之間搭建起跨越鴻溝的橋樑。

name: 邁克爾‧麥克格林
text:
[reaction]在你從一張[[槍械]]支援卡花費至少1子彈後：獲得1資源。(每輪每張[[槍械]]支援卡限制一次。)

real_text:

[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may place 1 ammo on a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
flavor: "管它是不是神。如果它和我作對，就一定會後悔。"
back_text: 牌組卡牌張數：30。 牌組構建選項：流浪者卡牌([rogue]) 等級0-3，中立卡牌等級0-5，屬性或文字框中帶有[[槍械]]字樣的卡牌等級0-5。 牌組構建需求(不計入牌組卡牌張數)："中提琴"盒、充公沒收、1張隨機基礎弱點。
back_flavor: 邁克爾‧麥克格林是一位沉默寡言的人。他無須多說什麼；因為他身邊有快槍手路易斯。他們兩位是歐巴尼恩最強的戰士，確保幫派在整個阿卡姆都受到尊重……直到那天晚上，河流裡的東西把路易斯從碼頭上拖了下去，在水底把他撕成碎片。邁克爾以為當他告訴老大們發生了什麼事情的時候，老大們會認為他瘋了，但事實更糟：他們告訴他，他們相信並讓這件事就這樣過去。但邁克爾不能讓他拍檔的死、或那晚他看到的東西，就這樣不了了之。他仍是一位沉默寡言的人。現在他將用他的槍來說話。

back_text: 牌組卡牌張數：30。 次級職階選擇：當牌組構建時，選擇守衛者([guardian])、探求者([seeker])或流浪者([rogue])。 牌組構建選項：潛修者卡牌([mystic])等級0-5，中立卡牌等級0-5，最多10張你所選次級職階的等級0-1事件卡和/或技能卡。 牌組構建需求(不計入牌組卡牌張數)：3張心靈感受性、3張末日預言(混洗入遭遇牌堆)、1張隨機基礎弱點。
back_flavor: 在她年幼時，歌莉婭被可怕的幻象所困擾。經過看了多年的醫生之後，她學會了透過寫故事來忘卻這些幻象。她怪異而令人不安的小說不知何故地深入人心，並使她成為一位暢銷書作家。但在她拜訪阿卡姆時，她經歷了有生以來最強烈的幻象。天空被撕裂開來，一隻醜陋的怪物憑空湧出。不知道為什麼，歌莉婭知道這個幻象是真實的，如果她不做點什麼，它就會變成現實。

[reaction]在你技能檢定成功後，消耗安堤基希拉：如果你成功且超過難度…
-…正好1點或3點，發現你所在地點的1個線索。
-…正好2點或4點，抽取1張卡牌並獲得1資源。
-…正好5點，你可以在你的下個回合期間進行額外一個行動。
real_text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test, exhaust Antikythera: If you succeeded by...
-...exactly 1 or 3, discover 1 clue at your location.
-...exactly 2 or 4, draw 1 card and gain 1 resource.
-...exactly 5, you may take an additional action during your next turn.
traits: 道具. 遺物. 科學

name: 羅伯特‧卡斯塔涅
text: 你獲得+1[combat]。 [action]從你的手牌丟棄一張佔用最多1個手部槽位的[[槍械]]支援卡並消耗羅伯特‧卡斯塔涅：結算被丟棄的支援卡上的一個攻擊能力，忽略所有費用。這不會引起趁亂攻擊。
real_text: You get +1 [combat]. [action] Discard a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand and exhaust Robert Castaigne: Resolve a Fight ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs. This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: 戲耍
text: [reaction]在你躲避一名敵人時，消耗戲耍：這次躲避你+1技能值且該敵人獲得警戒。如果你成功，抽取1張卡牌且不與該敵人解除交戰。
real_text: [reaction] When you attempt to evade an enemy, exhaust String Along: For this evasion attempt, you get +1 skill value and that enemy gains alert. If you succeed, draw 1 card and do not disengage from that enemy.

name: "你見過更糟的…"
text:
快速。在你所在地點或連接地點的一名調查員受到傷害和/或恐懼時打出。
該調查員可以花費最多3資源。每花費1資源，取消該調查員剛剛受到的1點傷害或1點恐懼。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may spend up to 3 resources. For each resource spent, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: 恐嚇
text: 談判。 選擇你所在地點的一名敵人並檢定[combat](X)，其中X為所選敵人的剩餘生命值。如果你成功，將該敵人混洗入遭遇牌堆(或改為對其造成2點傷害，如果其為[[精英]])。
real_text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [combat] (X), where X is the chosen enemy's remaining health. If you succeed, shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck (or deal 2 damage to it instead if it is [[Elite]]).
flavor: "你來錯地方了，孩子。"

name: 神槍手
text: 只能投入到你控制的[[槍械]]或[[Ranged]]支援卡上打印的能力的技能檢定。
real_text: Commit only to a skill test from an ability printed on a [[Firearm]] or [[Ranged]] asset you control.

name: "吃我一招"
text:
只能投入到你正在執行的技能檢定。作為投入"吃我一招"到技能檢定的額外費用，花費最多3資源。
如果你成功且超過難度至少1點，獲得該花費數量2倍的資源。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
flavor: "你仍在赤裸裸地炫耀。"

name: 羅伯特‧卡斯塔涅
text: 你獲得+1[combat]。 [fast]消耗羅伯特‧卡斯塔涅：攻擊。從你的手牌中揭示一張佔用最多1個手部槽位的[[槍械]]支援卡。結算所揭示的支援卡上的一個攻擊能力，忽略所有費用。然後，你可以丟棄所揭示的支援卡來抽取1張卡牌，或打出該支援卡(支付其費用)。
real_text: You get +1 [combat]. [fast] Exhaust Robert Castaigne: Fight. Reveal a [[Firearm]] asset that takes up 1 or fewer hand slots from your hand. Resolve a Fight ability on the revealed asset, ignoring all costs. Then, you may either discard the revealed asset to draw 1 card, or play that asset (paying its cost).

name: "你見過更糟的…"
text:
快速。在你所在地點或連接地點的一名調查員受到傷害和/或恐懼時打出。
該調查員可以給你最多5資源。本效果每給你1資源，該調查員取消剛剛受到的1點傷害或1點恐懼。
real_text:
Fast. Play when an investigator at your location or a connecting location is dealt damage and/or horror.
That investigator may give you up to 5 resources. For each resource given by this effect, that investigator cancels 1 damage or 1 horror just dealt.

name: 沉睡者之息
text: 使用(9充能)。 [action]：攻擊。這次檢定不使用使用你的[combat]，改為使用你的[willpower]。在這次檢定抽出混亂標記前，你可以花費最多3充能來額外抽出同等數量的混亂標記。選擇其中1個抽出的標記結算並忽略其餘標記。如果你成功且所選標記與一個被忽略的標記相符，這次攻擊造成+2傷害。
real_text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Fight. Use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, this attack deals +2 damage.

name: 入夢者之眼
text: 使用(9充能)。 [action]：調查。這次檢定不使用你的[intellect]，改為使用你的[willpower]。在這次檢定抽出混亂標記前，你可以花費最多3充能來額外抽出同等數量的混亂標記。選擇其中1個抽出的標記結算並忽略其餘標記。如果你成功且所選標記與一個被忽略的標記相符，發現你所在地點的額外1個線索。
real_text: Uses (9 charges). [action]: Investigate. Use your [willpower] instead of your [intellect] for this test. Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, you may spend up to 3 charges to reveal that many additional chaos tokens. Choose 1 of the revealed tokens to resolve and ignore the rest. If you succeed and the chosen token matches an ignored token, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 卡塔蓮娜‧索伊卡
text: [reaction]你在你執行的技能檢定期間抽出混亂標記時，消耗卡塔蓮娜‧索伊卡：從混亂袋抽出標記，直到抽出一個帶有符號的標記。結算該標記並忽略其餘標記。
real_text: [reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token during a skill test you are performing, exhaust Katarina Sojka: Reveal tokens from the chaos bag until a token with a symbol is revealed. Resolve that token and ignore the rest.
traits: 盟友. 預知. 入夢者

name: 賽羅塔夫手勢
text: 多重。封印([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。使用(3充能)。 強制 - 在你的回合開始時：你必須花費1充能，或丟棄賽羅塔夫手勢。 [fast]從你的手牌丟棄一張賽羅塔夫手勢：補充此賽羅塔夫手勢上的所有充能。
real_text: Myriad. Seal ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Uses (3 charges). Forced - When your turn begins: You must spend 1 charge or discard Sign of Xelotaph. [fast] Discard a copy of Sign of Xelotaph from your hand: Replenish all charges on this copy of Sign of Xelotaph.

name: 幽冥之盾
text: 快速。只能在你的回合期間打出。疊加到你所在地點帶有生命值和/或神智值的玩家卡。 強制 - 在疊加卡牌受到傷害/恐懼時：取消1點該傷害/恐懼。幽冥之盾的所有者必須從其控制的支援卡移除1充能。如果其不能，丟棄幽冥之盾。
real_text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to a player card with health and/or sanity at your location. Forced - When attached card takes 1 or more damage/horror: Cancel 1 of that damage/horror. The owner of Spectral Shield must remove 1 charge from an asset they control. If they cannot, discard Spectral Shield.

name: 劍杖
text: 快速。 [reaction]在劍杖入場後：你可以對與你交戰的一名敵人造成1點傷害。立即觸發以下"[action]"能力，無須支付其費用。 [action]消耗劍杖：攻擊/躲避。 這次攻擊或躲避你可以不使用你的[combat]或[agility]，改為使用你的[willpower]，並且這次檢定你+1技能值。
real_text: Fast. [reaction] After Sword Cane enters play: You may deal 1 damage to an enemy engaged with you. Immediately trigger the "[action]" ability below without paying its cost. [action] Exhaust Sword Cane: Fight/Evade. You may use your [willpower] in place of your [combat] or [agility] for this attack or evasion attempt and you get +1 skill value for this test.
traits: 道具. 遺物. 武器. 近戰

name: 如痴如醉
text:
每次技能檢定最多投入1張。
如果這次技能檢定在調查期間成功，在你所在地點的調查員控制的支援卡上放置總計最多3充能和/或秘密。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this skill test is successful during an investigation, place up to 3 charges and/or secrets on assets controlled by investigators at your location.

name: 悚異烙印
text: 永久。卓越。 在你購買本卡牌時，選擇你的牌組中的一張非專屬[[法術]]支援卡並在你的冒險日誌裡記錄[法術名稱]被烙印。此為你的烙印法術。你的牌組不能 包含超過1張烙印法術。 [reaction]在你抽取你的起始手牌前：在你的牌堆中查找並打出你的烙印法術(支付其費用)。
real_text: Permanent. Exceptional. When you purchase this card, choose a non-signature [[Spell]] asset in your deck and record [spell's name] was branded in your campaign log. This is your branded spell. Your deck cannot include more than 1 copy of your branded spell. [reaction] Before you draw your opening hand: Search your deck for your branded spell and play it (paying its cost).

name: 褻瀆神像
text: 只能從你的棄牌堆打出褻瀆神像。 強制 - 在褻瀆神像被擊敗時：不將其丟棄，改為將其混洗入你的牌堆。
real_text: Profane Idol can only be played from your discard pile. Forced - When Profane Idol is defeated: Shuffle it into your deck instead of discarding it.

name: "接住！"
text: 作為打出"接住！"的額外費用，從你的手牌或玩家區域選擇並丟棄一張佔用至少1個手部槽位的[[道具]]支援卡。 躲避。這次躲避你+X[agility]，其中X為所選支援卡的打印資源費用。如果你對非[[精英]]敵人躲避成功且該支援卡曾在你的玩家區域中，該敵人下個補給階段期間不準備。
real_text: As an additional cost to play "Catch!", choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Evade. You get +X [agility] for this evasion attempt, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed against a non-[[Elite]] enemy and that asset was in your play area, that enemy does not ready during the next upkeep phase.

name: 非常規手段
text: 作為打出非常規手段的額外費用，從你的手牌或玩家區域選擇並丟棄一張佔用至少1個手部槽位的[[道具]]支援卡。 調查。這次調查你+X[intellect]，其中X為所選支援卡的打印資源費用。如果你成功且該支援卡曾在你的玩家區域中，發現你所在地點的額外1個線索。
real_text: As an additional cost to play Unconventional Method, choose and discard an [[Item]] asset that takes up at least 1 hand slot from your hand or play area. Investigate. You get +X [intellect] for this investigation, where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost. If you succeed and that asset was in your play area, discover 1 additional clue at your location.

name: 沉思
text:
你可以投入沉思到你所在地點或連接地點的調查或談判期間的技能檢定。
如果這次檢定成功，執行檢定的調查員發現其所在地點的1個線索。
real_text:
You may commit Contemplative to an investigation or skill test during a parley attempt at your location or a connecting location.
If this test is successful, the performing investigator discovers 1 clue at their location.

name: 希望微光
text: 多重。 只能從你的棄牌堆打出希望微光。 將你棄牌堆中所有的希望微光加入你的手牌(包含本卡牌)。
real_text: Myriad. A Glimmer of Hope can only be played from your discard pile. Add all copies of A Glimmer of Hope in your discard pile to your hand (including this copy).

name: 殊死一搏
text:
只能投入到未投入其它卡牌的技能檢定。這次技能檢定不能投入其它卡牌。
你每有1張手牌，殊死一搏失去[wild]。如果這次檢定成功且投入了殊死一搏，抽取2張卡牌。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test with no other cards committed to it. Other cards cannot be committed to this skill test.
Last Chance loses [wild] for each card in your hand. If this test is successful while Last Chance is committed to it, draw 2 cards.

name: 苦行僧
text:
劇本模式專用。永久。每副牌組限制1張。只能當牌組構建時購買。
在你購買本卡牌時，獲得10點經驗。
在劇本剩餘時間內，你不能獲得經驗。
real_text:
Campaign mode only. Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. Purchase only at deck creation.
When you purchase this card, gain 10 experience.
For the remainder of the campaign, you cannot earn experience.

name: 自信
text:
每次檢定最多投入1張。
這次技能檢定期間每額外抽出一個混亂標記(即使其被取消或忽略)，自信獲得[wild](最多+3[wild]圖標)。
real_text:
Max 1 committed per test.
For each additional chaos token revealed during this skill test (even if it was canceled or ignored), Confidence gains [wild] (to a maximum of +3 [wild] icons).

name: 身心療法
text:
永久。每副牌組限制1張。
在你購買身心療法時，移除你的調查員的1點肉體或精神創傷。
real_text:
Permanent. Limit 1 per deck.
When you purchase Spiritual Healing, remove 1 point of physical or mental trauma from your investigator.

name: 脫陶之夢
text:
[[藝術家]]，[[預知]]，[[入夢者]]，[[藝人]]牌組專用。
只能投入到詭計卡上的技能檢定。如果這次技能檢定成功，不丟棄脫陶之夢，改為將其放置入你的玩家區域。
[reaction]在你從遭遇牌堆抽取一張非弱點詭計卡時，將脫陶之夢從遊戲中移除：取消其顯現效果並將其丟棄。
real_text:
[[Artist]], [[Clairvoyant]], [[Dreamer]], [[Performer]] deck only.
Commit only to a skill test on a treachery. If this skill test is successful, put Dreams of the Clay into play in your play area instead of discarding it.
[reaction] When you draw a non-peril treachery from the encounter deck, remove Dreams of the Clay from the game: Cancel its revelation effect and discard it.

name: 好奇心
text:
[[助理]]，[[米斯卡塔尼克]]，[[學者]]牌組專用。
如果這次技能檢定成功，執行檢定的調查員可以增加或減少成功且超過難度的點數最多2點(最低為成功且等於難度)。
real_text:
[[Assistant]], [[Miskatonic]], [[Scholar]] deck only.
If this skill test is successful, the performing investigator may succeed by up to 2 more or down to 2 less (to a minimum of zero).
flavor: "克里斯托弗博士絕對不會相信的！"

name: 奔向地平線
text: [[漂泊者]]，[[獵手]]，[[旅人]]牌組專用。 每位調查員限制1張。 [fast]在你的回合期間，丟棄1張手卡牌並消耗奔向地平線：移動。移動到連接地點。
real_text: [[Drifter]], [[Hunter]], [[Wayfarer]] deck only. Limit 1 per investigator. [fast] During your turn, discard 1 card from your hand and exhaust Bound for the Horizon: Move. Move to a connecting location.

name: 沃爾特‧菲茨帕特里克
text:
[[公務員]]，[[銀暮秘社]]，[[社會名流]]牌組專用。
你在談判的時候+1技能值。
[reaction]在你談判成功後，消耗沃爾特‧菲茨帕特里克：獲得1資源
real_text:
[[Civic]], [[Silver Twilight]], [[Socialite]] deck only.
You get +1 skill value while parleying.
[reaction] After you successfully parley, exhaust Walter Fitzpatrick: Gain 1 resource.
traits: 盟友. 贊助人. 銀暮秘社

name: 你出個價
text: [[罪犯]]，[[社會名流]]牌組專用。 談判。對你所在地點的一名敵人造成10點傷害(如果該敵人為[[精英]]，改為5點傷害)。將你出個價從遊戲中移除。
real_text: [[Criminal]], [[Socialite]] deck only. Parley. Deal 10 damage to an enemy at your location (5 damage instead if that enemy is [[Elite]]). Remove Name Your Price from the game.
flavor: "無論死活，我都能帶到你面前。"

name: 塞赫麥特兜帽
text:
[[信徒]]，[[天選]]，[[異教徒]]牌組專用。
[reaction]在你進入一個地點時，消耗塞赫麥特兜帽：直到本輪結束，該地點的所有非[[精英]]敵人不能與你交戰，並且你不能對那些敵人造成傷害。
real_text:
[[Believer]], [[Chosen]], [[Cultist]] deck only.
[reaction] When you enter a location, exhaust Cowl of Sekhmet: Until the end of the round, each non-[[Elite]] enemy at that location cannot engage you and you cannot deal damage to those enemies.
traits: 道具. 服裝. 遺物

name: 戰壕裝甲
text:
[[特工]]，[[警察]]，[[老兵]]牌組專用。
取消每輪第一次對你造成的趁亂攻擊。
real_text:
[[Agency]], [[Police]], [[Veteran]] deck only.
Cancel the first attack of opportunity made against you each round.

name: 昆陽之血
text: [[預知]]，[[獵手]]，[[法師]]牌組專用。 攻擊。這次攻擊你可以不使用你的[combat]，改為使用你的[willpower]。你每有一個空的手部槽位，這次攻擊你+2技能值並造成+1傷害。如果這次攻擊擊敗一名非[[精英]]敵人，將該敵人加入勝利牌區並疊加昆陽之血到該敵人。
real_text: [[Clairvoyant]], [[Hunter]], [[Sorcerer]] deck only. Fight. You may use your [willpower] instead of your [combat] for this attack. For each empty hand slot you have, you get +2 skill value and deal +1 damage for this attack. If this attack defeats a non-[[Elite]] enemy, add that enemy to the victory display and attach Blood of K'n-yan to it.

name: 風暴統馭者
text: [[祝福]]，[[預知]]，[[法師]]牌組專用。 [action]：攻擊。這次攻擊將你的[willpower]值加到你的技能值。如果這次攻擊成功，除了其基礎傷害外，你可以消耗風暴統馭者，來讓這次攻擊期間每抽出一個[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]和[elder_thing]符號，就對你所在地點的一名敵人造成1點傷害(最多額外3點傷害)。
real_text: [[Blessed]], [[Clairvoyant]], [[Sorcerer]] deck only. [action]: Fight. Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack. If this attack is successful, in addition to its standard damage, you may exhaust Storm Ruler to deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location for each [skull], [cultist], [tablet], and [elder_thing] symbol revealed during this attack (to a maximum of 3 additional damage).
traits: 道具. 遺物. 武器. 近戰

name: 勵志演說
text: [[公務員]]，[[藝人]]，[[社會名流]]牌組專用。 談判。選擇你所在地點的一位調查員。該調查員可以免費從其手牌打出一張[[盟友]]支援卡。然後，該調查員可以觸發該支援卡上的一個[action]或[fast]能力，忽略所有費用。
real_text: [[Civic]], [[Performer]], [[Socialite]] deck only. Parley. Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator may play an [[Ally]] asset from their hand at no cost. Then, that investigator may trigger an [action] or [fast] ability on that asset, ignoring all costs.
flavor: "沒錯，他們肯定買單了。"

name: 窮追不捨
text:
[[偵探]]，[[獵手]]，[[警察]]，[[記者]]牌組專用。
每位調查員限制1張。使用(5導引)。
[reaction]在你進入有至少1名敵人的地點後，花費1 導引並消耗窮追不捨：發現你所在地點的1個線索或對你所在地點的一名敵人造成1點傷害。
real_text:
[[Detective]], [[Hunter]], [[Police]], [[Reporter]] deck only.
Limit 1 per investigator. Uses (5 leads).

real_text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.
flavor:
The moon casts long shadows that reach across the ground like searching fingers.
You've always seen this city as home, but tonight Arkham feels like another place entirely.
back_text: Spawn 1 set-aside Gang Enforcer enemy engaged with the investigator with the most clues. Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
back_flavor:
Moving quickly down the avenue to your next destination, you see a suspicious-looking woman in a long coat step out from a nearby alley. You turn down a side street to avoid her and nearly run into a man with a wicked scar running down his right cheek. He takes a drag from his cigarette, tosses it to the sidewalk, and glowers at you. You step back only to bump into the woman you saw before. She smiles.
"Where you goin', pal? We just wanna talk."

name: Long Night
text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.
real_text: [reaction] After the last clue is discovered from an [[Arkham]] location: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck. One at a time, spawn each [[Criminal]] enemy discarded this way at the nearest empty location.
flavor: Your every step is dogged by both the Sheldons and the O'Bannions. It seems like the two warring gangs have put aside their beef to end your investigation.
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor:
No matter where you go, there seems to be a mobster waiting in every back alley, standing casually on the street corner, or watching from shop windows and park benches. It's too dangerous to continue your search, so you head back to Tillinghast's shop. A mob of gangsters intercepts you just a block away. The largest among them steps toward you menacingly, a lit cigarette clenched in his teeth, as his mooks restrain you.
"Didn't anyone ever tell you that curiosity killed the cat?" He leans down and puts his cigarette out on your cheek, then nods to his lackeys, who swiftly beat you down with brass knuckles, bare fists, and bricks.
Message received.

flavor: You've found yourself squarely in the center of a gang war!
back_flavor: As the conflict erupts into outright bloodshed, you locate a small crate labeled "Tillinghast Endeavors" in a back room. Keeping low to the ground, you scamper through the fight and back out to the cold evening air. The sound of shattering glass and heavy blows emanates from the building behind you. "Aw, applesauce," says a voice above you. A compact figure clad in black slides down a rappelling line and removes their mask. "I had a whole heist planned, you know. An informant. A calling card, even," Ruby says, tossing a yellow rose on the pavement. "I didn't think you could just walk in and ask politely, but, well, I guess you won fair and square."

flavor: You can navigate a path through the crumbling ruins via small pockets of air.
back_text: Each surviving investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
back_flavor: One wrong step sends you careening away from the ruined wall. As you look out into the abyssal darkness of the ocean depths, you have the illusion of drifting in the vastness of space. It is utterly serene. A sharp tug pulls your attention away: your line is caught on a falling chunk of foundation. Another sharp tug follows. You are drawn back to safety, but not without a heavy bruise and some wounded pride.

flavor: A softly pulsing light at the base of the ancient foundations beckons you to the sea floor. You must proceed carefully.
back_flavor: Andy Van Nortwick is the last to tumble into the ring of black columns at the base of the city. He looks out in awe at a shimmering energy field in the center of the underwater plaza. The field ripples around the columns like a persistent bubble, creating a pocket of breathable air. A long meandering tunnel winds from your position to the entrance of the underwater dome. You have reached the sea floor at last.

name: Ascend the Wall

real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Decrease your location's flood level. Objective – Make your way to the surface! If each surviving investigator is at Western Wall, you may advance.
flavor: It is a steep climb up the crumbling wall, but if you step carefully, you should reach the surface in one piece.
back_flavor: Ruby helps you up the slick black rocks to stand on the edge of what was once an ancient walkway. R'lyeh has risen noticeably since you arrived: the sunken western wall tower precariously over the turgid waters like an ancient citadel. The bay where you first made camp has receded as well. Not far off, you can see the Cassandra bob on the black waves. It won't be a long trek back to where you made landfall.

name: Stirring in the Dark
flavor: You can hear the sound of slithering and gnashing teeth in the darkness. Something awful stirs in the bowels of R'lyeh. You would rather not stick around to find out what it actually is...
back_text: Place clues on each location without victory X up to its clue value. Shuffle the set-aside Grotesque Amalgam enemy with the encounter discard pile and place those cards on the bottom of the encounter deck.
back_flavor: The tunnels branch and merge like blood vessels in a vast alien gullet. Every surface is covered in fleshy organic growths. What you first thought were tremors were the tunnels themselves: tightening and expanding like the muscles of a large trachea. As you round a corner, you see a nightmarish creature with sightless, buggy eyes slither out of sight.

name: Loathsome Parasites
text: Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda, if there are no non-[[Elite]] enemies in play: Reveal cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is revealed and spawn it (at an empty location, if able). Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the encounter deck.

Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the encounter deck.
flavor: Loathsome creatures emerge from every nook and cranny. If you don't escape soon, you have a feeling you'll become a permanent resident.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated.
back_flavor: A horde of stinking pustulous creatures chases you into a dark culvert. You hide within a fleshy fold of wall and hope for the best. After what feels like hours, the halls grow silent. Breathing a sigh of relief, you try to push the fold back only to find it has latched onto your arm with a sticky, gluey substance. As you try to pull away from it, the skin on your hand and arm sloughs off loosely, and with little pain. You stare in horror at your degloved palm. An orange tendril snakes past your ear to encircle your neck. You are being digested alive.

If The Inescapable is in play, heal 1 [per_investigator] damage from it and move it once toward the nearest investigator. Each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location during this movement.
back_flavor: The incessant cacophony makes it difficult to hear anything, even the sound of your pursuer's footfalls. He could be lurking around any corner. It is only a matter of time before you are found.

name: Ever-Shifting Walls
text: The Inescapable gets +2 [per_investigator] health. When The Inescapable moves via its hunter keyword, each location is considered to be connected to each adjacent location. flavor: With great effort and no small amount of luck, you may still be able to escape.
back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor: You find yourself trapped in a small cubic room. Dark water pours out of ancient sluices, rising to your waist, then chest, then neck. Your very bones seem to vibrate with the unceasing thrum of the heart of the city. Pushing panic aside, you press glowing nodes and panels in a futile attempt to drain the chamber, but to no result. Gulping a few last breaths, you dive down, searching for any way out. You just barely squeeze through a massive sluice, struggling against the current. At long last, you tumble out into a deep reservoir filled with icy black water. Below you, the silhouettes of star spawn swim slowly, inexorably toward you. They move without haste, for they know that there is no rush: you have no escape.

name: Careful Navigation
text: [reaction] After the investigators have translated any 3 of the following glyphs ([tdc_rune_l], [tdc_rune_m], [tdc_rune_n], [tdc_rune_p], [tdc_rune_o]): Reveal the Sealed Chamber location. (Hint: Each of these glyphs are found in this scenario.). Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator controls the Tidal Tablet story asset, advance.

(Hint: Each of these glyphs are found in this scenario.). Objective - When the round ends, if an investigator controls the Tidal Tablet story asset, advance.
flavor: The machinery that serves as the beating heart of R'lyeh is alien in design, but not inscrutable. Thanks to all you've learned up to this point, you may be able to find your way through.
back_text: Increase the flood level of each location that can have its flood level increased. Place clues on each revealed [[Vault]] location without victory X up to its clue threshold.
back_flavor:
With an undeniable sense of triumph, you pry the tablet from its resting place in the center of the chamber. It pulses in your hands in time to the thrumming machinery, sending ripples through the shallow water at your feet. Small tendrils of water snake upward to hang, suspended, around you. You wave the tablet once and watch the water on the floor rise and crash against the right wall of the chamber.
Satisfied with your find, you prepare to leave. However, you wonder if there are any other mysteries you have yet to uncover at the very heart of R'lyeh...

back_flavor: At long last, you reach the exit. After a short climb, you return to the towering precipice overlooking the ancient vault. There, you are surprised to find the other half of the expedition camped on the overlook, staring down at the churning machinery and turgid waters. Rather than press on, you and the others resolve to rest and share your findings as a group.

name: Ruined Archives

Suddenly, you feel the pillar loosen. Stepping away, you watch the intricately carved pillar tumble down to the bottom far below.

back_flavor: The tower shudders as all of R'lyeh continues to ascend. Ancient symbols on the court walls flash with blinding bright intensity. In your momentary blindness, you catch glimpses of blasphemous, hulking shapes of ancient creatures on what looks like a familiar black-sanded beach. An emerald sun reflects on oily black water of a distant alien shore. Every fiber of your being screams in protest as the sheer volume of history within the tower surges into your pitifully small mind all at once. Before you know it, you collapse on the stone floor and slip into a dark and restless slumber...

back_flavor: The otherworldly clouds churn above the ever-shifting skyline, glimmering with alien shapes. Ruby hangs over the edge of a skyscraper, laughing devilishly. "Don't be scared! This is how you know you're alive!" she shouts. Whatever she says next is drowned out by the crack of thunder, and a quickening gale. Ruby throws the end of her line to you and pulls herself to the top.

name: Return to the Shoreline
text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
real_text: [action] Spend X clues: Reveal X cards from the bottom of the Summit deck. You may put 1 revealed location into play in an adjacent open sky and move to it. (Place that open sky card and each other revealed card on top of the Summit deck in any order.) Objective - If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
flavor: You can recognize the western wall in the distance where you made landfall.
back_flavor:
A tremor nearly knocks you loose as you descend the treacherous spires. After several tense minutes, you finally descend to the streets. Andy sits on a glistening boulder, doing his best not to look shaken. "Well. That's another half a dozen rolls of film gone," he sighs with a melancholy air. "At least we're back in one piece. Well, mostly," he laughs, favoring his bandaged arm.
After the rest of your group are gathered, you make your way back to the beach where you made landfall.

"I have worked too hard to see my plans undone," Randall seethes. Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as he grasps at you weakly. Pulse pounding, you run for the shop exit and barrel out into the street. When you turn to look, the shop door has vanished yet again.
(→R1) (page 46).

"You're too late!" Randall wheezes, clutching his side. "The destruction of Arkham is at hand and you are powerless to stop it." Nightmarish shapes form around the antiquarian's head and shoulders as tchotchkes and ancient tomes fly off the shelves and hang suspended mid-air. Your vision blurs, then you find yourself back on the street. The shop has vanished yet again.
Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience. (→R2) (page 46).

back_flavor:
A quickening gale stirs the black water at Cthulhu's sagging legs. As glowing green sigils alight on the awful dead god's arms and legs, he looses an ear-splitting roar that shatters windows and shakes the very foundations of the city. Hunched over nearby, Andy intones a string of guttural words, holding one shaking hand over a glowing artifact. "It's working!" Ruby shouts.
Another roar. The sound of gunfire echoes across the water as the Arkham police try in vain to draw his attention. You look up to see the ancient one himself staring down at you, his eyes glowing a vivid crimson. The behemoth raises one clawed hand overhead to crush you like an insect.

text: As you walk with André, he mentions the trouble around the lot all started when the producer, Erika Strand, found the "deal of the century" on three props for the films. Ever since then, people have been acting strange, things have been disappearing, and the world just doesn't seem right.

back_text:
If it is act 1a:
As you continue to investigate, the air around Lot C becomes heavy and sour. Something is happening.
Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror. Gather 1 random [[Prop]] asset beneath Central Lot and set it aside, out of play. Add each remaining [[Prop]] asset beneath Central Lot to the victory display. Advance directly to act 1b.
Otherwise:
Your head spins. The world around you doesn't look quite right, although you can't say why, exactly.
Each investigator tests their lowest skill (2). Each investigator who fails loses 2 resources and loses 1 action during their next turn. Remember "the investigators made their call time."

flavor: Reality continues to warp and bend. It isn't just one film coming to life: all three are blending together in pure chaos.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
back_flavor: Whatever strange process was blending and warping realities seems to have ended. Lot C now contains a multitude of horrifying and fantastical worlds. Overhead, a swarm of bats flies under cover of dark storm clouds. A towering brontosaurus shambles out of a steaming prehistoric jungle and out onto a Saturnite landscape. Several extras pursue a hapless director into a silver rocket ship as werewolves howl atop rolling alien dunes. You look around wearily at the once hopeful Hollywood set, now filled with screams and chaos. Lot C is lost.

name: André's Request
text: Each Possessed Extra gains aloof. Objective - Investigate as many of the cursed props as you can. At the end of the round, if there are 2 or more [[Prop]] assets in the victory display, the investigators may advance.
real_text: Each Possessed Extra gains aloof. Objective - Investigate as many of the cursed props as you can. At the end of the round, if there are 2 or more [[Prop]] assets in the victory display, the investigators may advance.
flavor: The mishaps that have plagued Lot C all seem to stem from several strange props. By tracking them down, you may be able to put a stop to these unfortunate events.
back_text: Each investigator loses all of their clues. If there are any remaining cards beneath Central Lot, set them aside, out of play. Find the set-aside André Patel story asset and put it into play under the control of any investigator. He does not take up an ally slot for the remainder of the scenario. Proceed to Interlude: Take Two (page 8).

The golden serpent head stares at you menacingly, the green jewel in its mouth making your very bones vibrate. The sounds of dinosaur and alien insects and stalking creatures of the night rage around you in a tumultuous cacophony.

real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +1 fight, +1 health, and gains elusive. Exhausted enemies cannot be damaged. Objective - When the round ends, if the Accursed Cape is in the victory display, advance.
flavor: You and André have found yourselves trapped in a horror film... and you are the victims. You have to find the Contessa and wrest her cursed cape from her!
back_text: If The Contessa is in play, heal all damage from her and set her aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Move each investigator to Gothic Set. Each investigator loses all of their clues. Add each location with victory X and no clues on it to the victory display. Remove each [[Castle]] location from the game. Put each set-aside [[Set]] location into play, unrevealed, along with the Central Lot, (Blurred) side faceup. Search all out-of-play areas for The Contessa and spawn her at the Central Lot, (Enraged) side faceup. Search the victory display for the Accursed Cape and attach it to her. Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Reel deck into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 [cultist], 1 [tablet], and 1 [elder_thing] to the chaos bag.
back_flavor: The Contessa vanishes into a cloud of bats. You find yourself back in Lot C, but things have grown stranger...

name: Bloodbath
text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 fight, +2 health, and gains patrol (The Contessa) and the [[Monster]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Objective - Finish her! If The Contessa is defeated, advance.
real_text: Each Possessed Extra gets +2 fight, +2 health, and gains patrol (The Contessa) and the [[Monster]] trait. [fast] Spend 1 clue: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. Objective - Finish her! If The Contessa is defeated, advance.
flavor: An unnatural darkness overtakes Lot C. The Contessa has reclaimed her cape! If you hope to survive, you will need to defeat her once and for all.
back_flavor: "Fools! I am darkness. I AM THE NIGHT!" The Contessa bellows. The monstrous vampire claws at André as he struggles to pull the accursed cape off her. You hold her at bay until, with a final tug, André rips the cape in two. In a flash, sunlight cuts through the darkness overhead. The Contessa lets out one final scream, then explodes into a pile of grave dirt. All that is left of her is the blood red cape, torn to shreds.

back_text: Deck size: 40. Class Choices: At deck creation, choose 2 classes ([guardian], [seeker], [rogue], [mystic], or [survivor]). Deckbuilding Options: Neutral cards level 0-5, cards from your chosen classes level 0-4, cards from other classes level 0-1. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): 2 copies of Improvisation, 2 copies of Crisis of Identity, 1 random basic weakness. back_flavor: Lola had assumed that her days of performing The King in Yellow were behind her. Recently, however, she has heard a lone violin play the haunting melody from the show's last production. The music creeps into her mind in moments of silence and solitude, and she's compelled to visit the Ward Theatre one last time.

She'd only just paid off her new garage when Arkham was devastated by a cataclysmic flood, sending her business quite literally underwater. name: Past Curfew
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
flavor: The campus is strangely quiet, and there is no sign of your friend. Hooded figures cross the quad as nervous students scurry under painfully bright streetlamps.
back_text: In player order, each investigator tests [willpower] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 1 horror.
back_flavor: The wind carries the scent of smoke from across campus. A plume of flame rises from a nearby building.

name: Lit Up
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location.
flavor: The sky glows a faint orange as the flames spread.
back_text:
If they are still set aside, place 4 set-aside copies of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
In player order, each investigator tests [agility] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 1 damage.
back_flavor: Cinders fly through the air above Miskatonic University. The wail of a fire alarm resounds across the quad as dozens of frightened students flee the scene.

name: Wild Flames
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location. Forced - After doom is placed on the agenda: The lead investigator draws the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile
real_text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, discard a Bystander enemy at your location. Forced - After doom is placed on the agenda: The lead investigator draws the topmost copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile
flavor: The campus is ablaze!
back_text: Each surviving investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
back_flavor: Thick, black smoke fills the air around you as you fall to your knees, coughing. Hazy dark shapes move somewhere beyond the roaring flames. Try as you might, you cannot pull yourself to safety. Your vision swims as you lose consciousness.

name: Where There's Smoke...
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: You are searching the dormitories for any sign of your friend.
back_text:
Discard each enemy in play.
Put the set-aside Dormitories and Miskatonic Quad locations into play. Spawn the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy at the Dormitories.
Attach 1 set-aside copy of Fire! to Your Friend's Room. Place each other set-aside copy of Fire! in the encounter discard pile.
back_flavor: You find your friend's satchel, scorched with a stylized emblem of an open palm. Wherever your friend is, you imagine they didn't go willingly. As you turn to leave, you are confronted by a masked figure wreathed in flame. As the room erupts into flames around you, they let out a chilling wail.

name: Escape the Dorms
text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)
real_text: Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at Miskatonic Quad, advance. (Hint: Somcetimes it's better to run than to fight!)
flavor: A burning apparition stands between you and the exit. You must escape the dormitories!
back_text: Search all in-play and all out-of-play areas for the Servant of Flame, heal all damage from them, and set them aside, out of play. Discard each enemy in play. Discard all tokens and attachments from Your Friend's Room and remove it from the game. Put each remaining set-aside location (Orne Library, Science Hall, Warren Observatory) into play.
back_flavor: You emerge from the dormitories, lungs bursting, into the crisp autumn evening. Looking behind, there is no trace of your pursuer. You remember your friend planned to consult Miskatonic University's head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. He may be able to help you understand what is going on.

name: Searching for Dr. Armitage
text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
real_text: Objective - At the end of the round, investigators at Orne Library may spend the requisite clues, as a group, to advance.
flavor: Your friend had mentioned visiting the head librarian, Dr. Henry Armitage. With more and more strange figures arriving, you must scour the campus for his whereabouts.
back_text: Put the set-aside Dr. Henry Armitage story asset into play under any investigator's control. He does not take up an ally slot during this scenario. Put the set-aside Servant of Flame enemy into play at Miskatonic Quad. Place 3 [per_investigator] clues on Miskatonic Quad. The lead investigator must search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 [per_investigator] copies of Fire! and draw them. (Shuffle the encounter deck if it was searched.)
back_flavor:
You find Dr. Armitage barricaded in one of Orne Library's lecture halls.
"Some on campus have been acting strange lately, your friend among them. But all of that can wait. We must confront your pursuer and stop them before the entire campus burns!" Dr. Armitage says.

name: Blaze of Glory
text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to an enemy at your location. [action]: Resign. You flee the burning campus. (This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.) Objective - If the Servant of Flame is defeated: Advance.
real_text: [fast] Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Deal 1 [per_investigator] damage to an enemy at your location. [action]: Resign. You flee the burning campus. (This does not provoke attacks of opportunity.) Objective - If the Servant of Flame is defeated: Advance.
flavor: Your fiery nemesis can't be allowed to hurt more innocents! With Dr. Armitage's help, perhaps you can stop them.
back_flavor: Your nightmarish pursuer reels back, clutching both hands to their head, as if trying to pry their mask off. The sound of sirens in the distance grows louder. You turn to see a gaggle of terrified students rush past you. When you turn your attention back to your flaming nemesis, they have vanished into thin air.

name: Your Friend's Room
text: [action]: Engage. Choose an enemy at a connecting location. That enemy moves to this location and engages you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
real_text: [action]: Engage. Choose an enemy at a connecting location. That enemy moves to this location and engages you. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: The dorm is quickly filling with smoke.
back_flavor: Your friend's room is in utter disarray. But are these signs of a weary mind, or of some kind of struggle?

name: Servant of Flame
text: Hunter. Prey (lowest [agility]). Retaliate.
real_text: Hunter. Prey (lowest [agility]). Retaliate.

name: Dr. Henry Armitage
text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
The first action you perform each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
real_text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
The first action you perform each round does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
flavor: "I've seen more than my share of strange occurrences."

name: Miskatonic Quad
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)
real_text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Group limit once per round.)
back_flavor: The quad is the central crossroads of Miskatonic University.

name: Dormitories
text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
real_text: [action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: There's never a dull moment in the university dorms.
back_flavor: Recently renovated, the dormitories boast some of the best modern conveniences, including air conditioning, flush toilets, and a communal ice box.

name: Science Hall
text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Science Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
real_text: Forced - After you discover 1 or more clues at Science Hall: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand.
flavor: The students are never exactly sure what will be under the microscope each day.
back_flavor: The construction of the West Memorial Science Hall at the northern end of campus is confusing, to say the least. However, students nevertheless are more than happy for the modern facilities and state-of-the-art science equipment.

name: Warren Observatory
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
flavor: To date, Miskatonic astronomers have identified at least 15 separate stars that appear to have gone missing from the Northern Hemisphere.
back_flavor: A generous grant from Tillinghast Endeavors has allowed the university to bring the storied observatory back, bigger and better than ever.

name: Orne Library
text: [action][action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
real_text: [action][action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Students have reported strange sounds coming from the empty archives at night...
back_flavor: To take every precaution since the flood, the Orne librarians have cleared out the basement archives and worked to waterproof the building.

name: Cantor of Flame
text: Retaliate.
real_text: Retaliate.
flavor:
"By flame and blade, in shade and blood
Our queen reborn after the flood."
-Edict of Ash, Vol XIX

name: Hellhound
text: Hunter. Forced - After Hellhound attacks you during the enemy phase: Choose and discard 1 asset you control.
real_text: Hunter. Forced - After Hellhound attacks you during the enemy phase: Choose and discard 1 asset you control.

flavor: They say curiosity killed the cat. But will it kill you, too?

name: Arkham Alive
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
flavor: An unnatural haze fills the streets of Arkham. Some of the locals say the hills west of Arkham are burning. Despite the cool autumn weather, the city streets feel unnaturally warm as evening falls.
back_text: One at a time, each investigator draws 1 copy of the set-aside Mark of Elokoss weakness. Each investigator is now the bearer of that weakness. <i>(Add that card to that investigator's deck, ignoring deckbuilding restrictions. It does not count toward that investigator's deck size.
back_flavor: An itch you've done your best to ignore becomes unbearable. Pulling back your sleeve reveals a patch of peeling gray skin. Gingerly, you scratch the dead skin to reveal a smooth scar, almost as though you were branded. The scar resembles a hand with an unblinking eye inset into it. Touching it gives you a warm, heady feeling, like being drunk.

name: Emergent Evils
text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
real_text: [action]: Resign. You return to compare notes with Dr. Armitage on your friend's whereabouts.
flavor: Steam rises off of the wet pavement, as though the ground beneath it were actually burning.
back_text: Each investigator immediately resigns.
back_flavor: You check your watch and realize it is already half past 11. Cursing, you hail a cab to make your way to Easttown.

name: Augurs of Flame
text: [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the facedown card beneath your location. Objective - If there are a total of 6 [[Elite]] enemies in the victory display and/or under the act, advance. (Hint: Either defeat the suspects by force or resolve their codex entries to generate leads for your investigation!)
real_text: [action] Spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the facedown card beneath your location. (Hint: Either defeat the suspects by force or resolve their codex entries to generate leads for your investigation!)
flavor: You must find the whereabouts of the suspects on your friend's list.
back_flavor: Your search has turned up some interesting results. With all that you've learned, you and Dr. Armitage should have enough clues to find your friend's whereabouts. You hail a cab back to Easttown to discuss your findings.
