name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Gain 1 resource.
real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Gain 1 resource.
flavor: It's fairly easy to take out a loan from the First Bank of Arkham, but don't forget to read the fine print...
back_flavor: There's never a quiet night in Downtown. Arkham's busiest district is home to glamorous new theaters, hotels, high-rises, and the finest dining in all of Massachusetts (or so they say).

name: Downtown
text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.
real_text: [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this location: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.
flavor: Of course, nobody mentions the sanatorium.
back_flavor: There's never a quiet night in Downtown. Arkham's busiest district is home to glamorous new theaters, hotels, high-rises, and the finest dining in all of Massachusetts (or so they say).

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Heal up to 2 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at this location. (Limit once per game.)
real_text: [action]: Heal up to 2 damage from among investigators and/or [[Ally]] assets at this location. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: Arkham's only hospital is flush with patients and put-upon nurses.
back_flavor: The newest district in Arkham is filled with fashionable shops, swinging jazz music, and a growing population of students and young newcomers.

name: Uptown
text: [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If no card was added in this way, draw 1 card.
real_text: [action]: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] or [[Ritual]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck. If no card was added in this way, draw 1 card.
flavor:
"Come to Ye Olde Magick Shoppe to discover the wonders of REAL magic. Stage magicians will not be served."
-Local Advertisement
back_flavor: The newest district in Arkham is filled with fashionable shops, swinging jazz music, and a growing population of students and young newcomers.

name: Northside
text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Discover 1 clue from any revealed [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per round.)
real_text: [action] Spend 5 resources: Discover 1 clue from any revealed [[Arkham]] location. (Limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Northside is an industrial hub, boasting modern factories, cheap housing for migrant workers, and the newly restored Arkham Advertiser.

name: Easttown
text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Easttown: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it (paying its cost). Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
real_text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Easttown: Search your deck for an [[Ally]] asset and play it (paying its cost). Shuffle your deck. (Limit once per game.)
back_flavor: The oldest district in Arkham, Easttown hasn't aged well. While Hibb's Roadhouse and Velma's Diner are well-frequented establishments, newcomers find very little else inviting.

name: Merchant District
text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
real_text: [fast] During your turn, if there are exactly 1 or 2 investigators in the game: Move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Since the flood, the Merchant District has become a focal point for business and development in Arkham. Each day seems to bring in more and more construction, workers, and industry.

name: Waterfront District
text: As an additional cost to investigate Waterfront District, you must spend 1 action.
real_text: As an additional cost to investigate Waterfront District, you must spend 1 action.
flavor: Anyone who doesn't want to walk in waist-high water needs to hitch a ride from one of the locals.
back_flavor: With its streets perpetually flooded, the former Rivertown district is a ghost town. Only dour factories, with their heavy cement foundations, are able to stand among the waterlogged shanties.

name: Southside
text: [action][action]: Investigators at this location draw a combined total of 3 cards, divided as they choose. (Group limit once per round.)
real_text: [action][action]: Investigators at this location draw a combined total of 3 cards, divided as they choose. (Group limit once per round.)
back_flavor: Situated on the southern slope of French Hill, Southside is perhaps the most welcoming and quiet of Arkham's districts.

name: French Hill
text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
real_text: [action] Choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Place 1 charge or secret on an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
back_flavor: The stately homes of French Hill have fallen into disrepair as the old families slowly die out.

name: Miskatonic University
text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Deal 1 direct damage to each player card with health at Miskatonic University.
real_text: Forced - When the investigation phase ends: Deal 1 direct damage to each player card with health at Miskatonic University.
back_flavor: Arkham's own Miskatonic University is often a source of rumors and gossip. The university's restricted archives are a subject of great interest, and the campus is often awash with chatter about the strange findings of its curious faculty.

name: Miskatonic University
text: [action]: Play a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)
real_text: [action]: Play a [[Tome]] or [[Spell]] asset from your discard pile, reducing its cost by 2. (Limit once per game.)

name: Brethren of Ash
text: Forced - When doom would be placed on a card: Each investigator takes 1 direct damage, instead. Forced - If each remaining investigator is defeated: Advance. Objective - If Elokoss is defeated, (→R1) (page 13).

back_text: Each investigator is killed.
back_flavor:
A knotted, claw-like hand grabs your arm as dozens more wrap around you, embracing you. The touch burns. You scream as a horrifying, toothy maw opens in Elokoss' belly.
"Don't worry. She only wants to honor you," says a familiar voice.
You look behind you to see your friend wearing the same black and red robes as the rest of the Brethren of Ash. They grin at you as tongues of flame billow out from the burning maw, enveloping you in a cocoon of fire. The last thing you hear as you are pulled into the white-hot inferno in Elokoss' chest is your friend - along with the rest of the cult - singing a lilting, off-key hymn for your rebirth.

Shuffle each other copy of Fire! into the encounter deck, along with the set-aside Queen's Knight and Herald of Flame enemies. Put the set-aside Sluice Control location into play.

back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Know the Exit, Know the Line, Know the Scene, Weight of the World, 1 random basic weakness.
back_flavor: When André turned 13, his parents scrounged up just enough money to buy him a ticket to the Central Paris Theatre. Enamored by the art form, André quickly became obsessed with the silver screen, working tirelessly to act his way to Hollywood. There, while filming A Cosmic Journey, he experienced inexplicable and world-altering happenings. As the lines between reality and fantasy began to blur in his mind, his peer and friend, Betsy Baxter, suggested a change of scenery. At her recommendation, André packed up and moved to the small town of Arkham, Massachusetts for a much-needed break.

只能投入你正在進行的技能檢定。將"吃我一招！"投入技能檢定時，花費最多3資源作為額外費用。
如果你成功且超過難度至少1點，獲得同等花費數量的兩倍的資源。
real_text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing. As an additional cost to commit "Watch this!" to a skill test, spend up to 3 resources.
If you succeed by 1 or more, gain twice that many resources.
flavor: 赤裸裸的炫耀。

name: 撬鎖工具
text: 使用(3補給)。如果撬鎖工具上沒有補給，將其丟棄。 [action]消耗撬鎖工具：調查。這次調查中將你的[agility]數值加入你的技能值。如果你沒有成功並超過難度至少2點，移除撬鎖工具上的1補給。
real_text: Uses (3 supplies). If Lockpicks has no supplies, discard it. [action] Exhaust Lockpicks: Investigate. Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation. If you do not succeed by at least 2, remove 1 supply from Lockpicks.
traits: 道具. 工具. 違法

name: 黑色扇子
text:
卓越。
只要你有……
- ……10+資源，你獲得+1生命和+1神智。
- ……15+資源，在你回合中你可以進行一次額外行動。
- ……20+資源，你的每項技能+1。
real_text:
Exceptional.
While you have...
- ...10+ resources, you get +1 health and +1 sanity.
- ...15+ resources, you may take one additional action during your turn.
- ...20+ resources, you get +1 to each of your skills.

name: 良好人脈
text:
每位調查員限制1張。
[fast]消耗良好人脈：你每有4資源，本次技能檢定的技能值+1。
[fast]花費2資源：準備良好人脈。(每輪限制一次。)
real_text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[fast] Exhaust Well Connected: You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 4 resources you have.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: Ready Well Connected. (Limit once per round.)

name: 紅色鬧鐘
text: 卓越。使用(0充能)。 強制 - 在你的回合開始後：你可以取走此處所有充能，作為資源。在此放置1充能。如果其正好有…… - 1充能，下次技能檢定你+4技能值。 - 2充能，你可以移動最多3次. - 3充能，這回合你可以進行2個額外行動。
real_text: Exceptional. Uses (0 charges). Forced - After your turn begins: You may take all charges here, as resources. Place 1 charge here. If it has exactly... - 1 charge, you get +4 skill value for your next skill test. - 2 charges, you may move up to 3 times. - 3 charges, you may take 2 additional actions this turn.

name: 荒唐的素描像
text:
只能在你所在地點有至少1個線索時打出。
抽取3張卡牌。
real_text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

name: 推理
text: 如果調查一個地點時本技能檢定成功，額外發現該地點的1個線索。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
flavor: 我就知道我看過這個符號。我現在通知其他人還為時不晚！

name: 放大鏡
text:
快速。
你在調查時獲得+1[intellect]。
[free]如果你所在地點沒有線索：將放大鏡返回你的手牌。
real_text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.
flavor: 清清楚楚的世界，有時候不一定是你想看到的。

name: 推理
text: 如果調查一個地點時本技能檢定成功，額外發現該地點的1個線索(如果超過難度至少2點，改為額外發現2個線索)。
real_text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location (2 additional clues instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
flavor: 我就知道我看過這個符號。我現在通知其他人還為時不晚！

name: 新晉術士
text: 強制 - 在新晉術士入場後：在該卡上放置1個毀滅標記。 [free] 消耗新晉術士：在你牌堆頂部3張卡牌中查找並抽取1張[[法術]]卡。混洗你的牌堆。
real_text: Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it. [fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

name: Second Sight
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Investigate ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to discover 1 additional clue at your location. If you reveal a [cultist] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Second Sight (if you cannot, take 1 horror and discard this card).

name: 力量洪流
text:
將力量洪流投入技能檢定時，從你控制的支援卡上花費最多3充能作為額外費用。
每以此方式花費1點充能，力量洪流獲得[willpower][wild]。
real_text:
As an additional cost to commit Torrent of Power to a skill test, spend up to 3 charges from among assets you control.
For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].

name: 幸運兔腳
text: [reaction]在你技能檢定失敗後，消耗幸運兔腳：抽取1張卡牌。
real_text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
flavor: 他們都說這不會帶來任何好運。我倒是覺得寧信其有，不信其無。

name: M1911
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
real_text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

name: 致命打擊
text: 如果攻擊中的這次技能檢定成功，則該次攻擊造成+1傷害(如果超過難度至少2點，改為造成+2傷害)。
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage (+2 damage instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
flavor: 大斧砸在肉上，發出令人作嘔的響聲，他停不住地反覆打擊著那個怪物，直到它再也無法動彈為止。

name: Cosmic Flame
text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).
real_text: Uses (3 charges). [action]: Fight ([willpower]). If you succeed, you may spend 1 charge to deal +1 damage for this attack. If you reveal a [skull] token during this test, remove 1 charge from Cosmic Flame (if you cannot, take 1 damage and discard this card).

name: Vicious Blow
text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
real_text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over... until at last, it stopped moving.
